evidence_quote: This study aimed to quantify exercise-induced GI symptoms, gut fullness, blood glucose response, and ratings of perceived exertion in response to low-protein (LP) and moderate-protein (MP) pre-exercise shake.
rationale: The study examines pre-exercise protein intake and gastrointestinal tolerance in runners. It does not investigate brain or neural mechanisms, cognition, neural injury, or neurological disorders and their treatments or biomarkers.
